served_graph_reused_entry_choice: the two graphs the T25 compile seed produced (expected_new=2), not the predecessor's seeded graph 4d4531e8..., which is present in this root by copy
served_graph_reused_proves: two facts: (1) the run added NO entry to the compile root, so it compiled nothing new, and (2) both T25 graph entries 301f479170329f3b9bffbc4f9c5736be, c3f74100dfeed892706f9b3488c90c2b are present after the run. Together they are consistent with the leg having loaded the graphs the serving candidate compiled
served_graph_reused_does_not_prove: WHICH entry the engine actually loaded. The root holds six entries, four of them seeded from the predecessor's root; this reading does not observe the load itself, so it cannot distinguish loading a T25 graph from loading a seeded entry already present. Proving that needs a load-side observation (a NEFF load signal or a cache-hit line naming the entry), which this procedure does not take
